title: The 10 Best Cordless Hedge Trimmers
subtitle: Battery-powered hedge trimmers for shrubs and hedges, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A cordless hedge trimmer shapes shrubs and hedges with no cord to cut and no engine to start. We ranked 10 best-sellers from BLACK+DECKER, WORX, EGO, Greenworks, CRAFTSMAN and budget brands on rating, review volume and features (a 22-inch or longer blade, a battery in the box, 3/4-inch or bigger cut capacity and dual-action blades).

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER 20V MAX 22" Cordless Hedge Trimmer with Battery and Charger (LHT2220)

specs.extras: Up to 3,000 sq ft of hedge per charge, 40% less vibration

products.verdict: The best-selling hedge trimmer here: a 22-inch dual-action blade that cuts branches up to 3/4 inch, up to 3,000 sq ft of hedge per charge, and 4.7 stars on 7,330 reviews.
products.best_for: Most homeowners with hedges and shrubs.
products.skip_if: You have overgrown hedges with 1 inch branches.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER 20V MAX 18" Cordless Hedge Trimmer with Battery (LHT218C1)
products.verdict: A shorter 18-inch version for small shrubs and tight spots, with 2,400 cuts per minute.
products.skip_if: You trim long hedges; the 22-inch LHT2220 is the same price range.

products.name: WORX 20V 22" Cordless Hedge Trimmer (WG261)
products.verdict: A light 5.5 lb WORX with a 22-inch dual-action blade and a 2.0Ah battery that fits WORX's 75+ Power Share tools.
products.best_for: WORX owners and anyone who wants a light 22-inch trimmer.
products.skip_if: You need it now; Amazon listed it shipping in 7 to 12 days.

products.name: EGO POWER+ 26" Cordless Hedge Trimmer with 56V 2.5Ah Battery (HT2601)

specs.extras: Carbon fiber rail with lifetime warranty, up to 60 min

products.verdict: The most capable trimmer here: 26-inch dual-action blades that cut up to 1.2-inch branches, a carbon fiber rail with a lifetime warranty and up to 60 minutes per charge.
products.skip_if: You have a few small shrubs.

products.name: MZK 20V 22-Inch Cordless Hedge Trimmer with 2 x 4Ah Batteries (ET1609)
products.verdict: A budget kit with two 4.0Ah batteries, a 22-inch blade and a 5 lb body, for well under brand-name prices.
products.best_for: Budget buyers who want long runtime.
products.skip_if: You need to cut thicker than 5/8 inch.

products.name: DocSmart Brushless Cordless Hedge Trimmer with Two Batteries (HT02-B)
products.verdict: A brushless budget trimmer with two batteries the seller says give 120 minutes combined.

products.name: Greenworks 80V 26" Brushless Cordless Hedge Trimmer, 2.0Ah Battery (2216802)
products.verdict: An 80V brushless trimmer with 26-inch blades for long hedge runs, on Greenworks' pro 80V platform.
products.skip_if: You want light weight; it's 7.2 lb.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN V20 20" Cordless Hedge Trimmer with Battery and Charger (CMCHT810C1)
products.verdict: A CRAFTSMAN V20 trimmer that cuts 3/4-inch branches, rated 4.7 stars.
products.skip_if: You want long runtime; the included battery is 1.5Ah.

products.name: Greenworks 24V 20" Brushless Hedge Trimmer, 2.0Ah Battery (HT2002)
products.verdict: A compact brushless 24V trimmer that still cuts 1.1-inch branches at 4,000 strokes per minute.
products.best_for: Thick shrubs in a small, light package.
products.skip_if: You want lots of reviews; it has 40.

products.name: KOMASTY 22" Cordless Hedge Trimmer with 2 Batteries and Charger
products.verdict: A budget 22-inch trimmer that cuts 3/4-inch branches with two batteries, rated 4.7 stars.
products.best_for: Budget buyers who want full features.

avoid.name: 2-in-1 600W 21V Cordless Hedge Trimmer, Green
avoid.flag: No blade length or cut capacity listed; 600 W claim
avoid.verdict: A $20 handheld shear sold as a hedge trimmer, with no blade length or cutting capacity anywhere in the listing.
reasons: The listing never states the blade length or the thickest branch it can cut, the two numbers that decide what a hedge trimmer can handle.
It claims a '600W high power motor' on a small 21V handheld with no amp or runtime figure to back it.
The model number (LLJFXIN260602) and part number (llj2255654) don't match, and nothing ties the product to a traceable maker. The BLACK+DECKER LHT2220 states 22 in and 3/4 in.

buyers_guide.q: What blade length do I need?
buyers_guide.a: 18 to 20 inches for small shrubs and tight spots. 22 inches covers most hedges. 24 to 26 inches makes long, flat runs faster but adds weight.
The thickest branch the blades can cut. 5/8 to 3/4 inch handles yearly trimming; overgrown hedges need 1 inch or more, like the EGO HT2601 or Greenworks HT2002.
Both blades move in opposite directions, which cuts faster and vibrates less than a single moving blade. Nearly every trimmer here is dual-action.

buyers_guide.q: Hedge trimmer or pole hedge trimmer?
buyers_guide.a: For hedges taller than you can comfortably reach, a pole hedge trimmer or an attachment on a pole saw saves using a ladder.

buyers_guide.q: How do I keep the blades working?
buyers_guide.a: Wipe off sap and spray a lubricant after each use. Sharp, clean blades cut cleaner and drain the battery less.
